text:
ravi: Heads-up: billing job bill-2026-03-25-11 created two invoices for customer 'BlueRiver' (cust_221). inv_227500A = $4,450, inv_227500B = $3,950. The smaller one is missing 'Premium Support 5%'. Job id: run-7811. @billing-team

acct-bot: automated retry created inv_227500B after initial pdf timeout.

tara: I ran check: inv_227500A line_items=[usage:380000,support:19000,tax:7000]; inv_227500B line_items=[usage:395000]. Looks like support line never attached on the retry invoice.

mike: logs show billing-worker threw 502 when attaching optional lines, then retried and created a new invoice but skipped optional attach due to job_run guard. File: billing/worker/attach.py:101.

ravi: Any payments captured?

acct-bot: payment status: both uncaptured. No refunds needed.

tara: Proposed immediate actions: 1) pause exporter for run-7811; 2) mark inv_227500B voided with note 'duplicate from retry, missing support line SPT-1530'; 3) reissue corrected invoice inv_227500C. Need accounting sign-off to void.

mike: I'll open a hotfix PR to make attach operation idempotent and add unique constraint on invoice_lines (invoice_id, code).

infra: paused exporter for run-7811 and created ticket ENG-BILL-940.

ravi: I approve the void (no captured payment). Tara, please draft message to customer and include both invoice ids.

tara: Draft: "Hi BlueRiver — we found an automation error where a retry created a duplicate invoice missing a support line. We will void inv_227500B and issue corrected invoice inv_227500C today. No action required on your side." Will send after void applied.

mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/436 — adds idempotency, unique constraint, and tests. Staging deploy scheduled in 45m.

ravi: Thanks. Adding this to month-end audit notes & SPT ticket link in invoice history. :thumbsup:
